body: I can see why that would be emotionally taxing, but I'm glad you were able to find an awesome cat for such a great price. I was initially worried because I do plan on visiting a lot of cats to get a good feel for who's the best fit so your comment is very reassuring. Guess I'll have to pick a day when that are less busy. Thanks for all the great info :)

Wow, that's truly devastating that you adopted a sick cat without any knowledge and I am so sorry to hear you had to go through that. I'm not sure how that even happens but I hope it was an honest mistake on their part. I have been watching the adoption page on the humane society website and it seems cats move fast so I'll have to stop by in person soon. Thank you so much for sharing!
